title: 2001 AMC 8 Problem 8

concepts.label: Power scaling of length, area, and volume

statement: Genevieve puts bracing on her large kite in the form of a cross connecting opposite corners of the kite. How many inches of bracing material does she need?

solutions.text:
The long diagonal is \(7\) units, and the short one is \(6\) units.

In the large kite, one unit is \(3\) inches, so the total amount of bracing material needed is \[ 3(7 + 6) = 3 \cdot 13 = 39. \]

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: The bracing is the sum of the two diagonals
Tripling the grid triples both diagonal lengths
